solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Serviceable bulb discovered after blown fuse

indicators.note: after says the bulb's remnant comes behind the shuffled fuse
a fuse that has blown is wrecked, so its letters are rearranged
with its cover removed, bulb loses its outside letters

explanation.surface: A light bulb found to be working once the blown fuse has been dealt with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discovered' means with its cover off: the bulb loses its outer letters rather than being found.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something that does its job and can be put to practical purpose.

clue.text: Absolute ruler's after that woman

indicators.note: after puts the ruler behind the woman

parts.note: she refers to that woman
ER is the Queen's royal cipher, a ruler; 's means is

explanation.surface: A monarch is tyrannical after a particular woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Total or complete, as in utter nonsense.

clue.text: Struggling chain's cutting almost zero-cost concession

indicators.note: cutting says the jumble goes into the shortened word
almost loses the last letter of the word for zero-cost

parts.note: something zero-cost is free

indicators.note: struggling suggests twisting, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A failing retail chain cuts into a near-free trading deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Struggling' rearranges chain's to ANCHIS, and 'cutting' places it inside FRE ('almost' zero-cost free).
explanation.definitionFit: A licence granted to trade under another firm's name is a concession.

clue.text: Voter rejecting European academic

indicators.note: rejecting means the abbreviation is thrown out

parts.note: an elector is a voter

explanation.surface: A voter turns down a European academic.
explanation.definitionFit: A university lecturer, especially at Oxford or Cambridge, holds this title.

clue.text: After drink, got sharper and was diverting

indicators.note: After puts the sharpening word behind the drinking word

parts.note: to sip is to drink a little
a blade honed has been made sharper

explanation.surface: Someone takes a drink, perks up, and becomes entertaining company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was diverting' looks like 'was entertaining', but here it means drawing liquid off through a tube.
explanation.definitionFit: To siphon fuel or funds is to draw them off elsewhere, a kind of redirecting.

clue.text: In the plate's some fried food

indicators.note: fried suggests the letters are cooked up into a new order

explanation.surface: A bit of fried food sitting on the plate.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick egg-and-potato dish from Spain, a kind of food served at tapas bars.

clue.text: Cabbage salad, nearly new, garnished with simple herb

indicators.note: the salad is garnished with, so wrapped in, the word for simple

parts.note: pure means simple or unadulterated

indicators.note: nearly drops the last letter of the salad

parts.note: slaw is a cabbage salad

explanation.surface: A cabbage salad, almost fresh, dressed with a plain herb.
explanation.walkthrough: Coleslaw is often shortened to slaw, the cabbage salad; 'garnished with' makes the simple word wrap round it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fleshy-leaved plant used in salads and as a potherb.

clue.text: Outstanding old part of building

parts.note: a wing is a section of a building

explanation.surface: An impressive old part of a building.
explanation.walkthrough: Outstanding looks like excellent; it means still unpaid.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt still unpaid is outstanding.

clue.text: Got to get trained

definitions.meaning: got to means bothered or worried
trained as in drilled or put through physical work

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both upset and having been put through physical training.

clue.text: It's dangerous to drop litter like this!

definitions.text: It's dangerous to drop litter like this!

parts.words: It's dangerous to drop litter like this!
parts.note: litter here is a carried seat on poles for a passenger, not rubbish, and dropping one with its occupant would be dangerous

explanation.surface: A sign warning people not to throw rubbish down.
explanation.walkthrough: Litter suggests rubbish; it is the old covered seat borne on poles by two carriers.
explanation.definitionFit: This enclosed seat carried by bearers is a classic kind of litter, so dropping one is hazardous.

clue.text: Time Out feature

indicators.note: out as in out of order, so the letters of Time are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A piece in the London listings magazine Time Out.
explanation.walkthrough: Time Out, a London listings magazine, reads as one title; 'Out' is the anagram signal on Time.
explanation.definitionFit: A single article or report in a newspaper or magazine is a feature or piece.

clue.text: Member of Greens trashed cool crib

indicators.note: something trashed is wrecked, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A Green Party member vandalises a fashionable flat.
explanation.walkthrough: Greens suggests the political party; it means green vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: This brassica is a green vegetable, one of those collectively called greens.

clue.text: What's left — perhaps a hundred yen?

definitions.text: What's left — perhaps a hundred yen?

parts.note: in cricket the leg side is to the left of a right-handed batsman
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
Y is an abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: Someone inherits a paltry sum after a death.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side lies to a right-handed batsman's left. The whole clue also defines: a hundred yen might be the sum left to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A bequest is money or property left to someone in a will.

clue.text: National match broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means the word is heard rather than written

parts.note: a tie is a match or fixture, as in a cup tie

explanation.surface: A national sporting fixture being shown on television.
explanation.walkthrough: National looks like an adjective; it is a noun, a citizen of a country.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of Thailand is a national of that country.

clue.text: Passes with ease

definitions.meaning: passes on, as possessions passed to a younger generation

explanation.definitionFit: Hand-me-downs are things passed down; winning easily is winning without contest.

clue.text: She seeks trophy — lock of invader's hair?

indicators.note: lock of the invader's hair puts the invader first, then the lock

parts.note: the Huns were invaders of Europe
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: A woman chasing a prize: maybe a lock of a barbarian's hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A female hunter pursues game, and trophies such as antlers, as her quarry.

clue.text: Shuffle bottom and move all over the place

parts.note: rear is a word for bottom
to range is to roam widely

explanation.surface: Someone shifting their bottom and fidgeting about.
explanation.definitionFit: Shuffle cards or papers means put them into a new order.

clue.text: Diminutive setter perhaps with special interest in takeaway food

parts.note: a setter is a breed of dog, and doggy is a childish diminutive for a dog
one's bag is one's speciality or thing

explanation.surface: A short compiler with a hobby in takeaways.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter is a dog, not the puzzle's compiler.
explanation.definitionFit: Restaurant leftovers carried home in a container are sometimes given this name.

clue.text: Lobby to return wilderness alongside volcano

indicators.note: to return means the combined letters are read backwards
alongside places the volcano next to the wilderness

parts.note: a moor is open wild land
Etna is the Sicilian volcano

explanation.surface: Campaigning to give wild land and a volcano back.
explanation.definitionFit: A lobby is an entrance hall or waiting room leading to a larger chamber.

clue.text: Heard, saw tots

indicators.note: Heard means the word is spoken, not written

parts.note: an adze is a cutting tool, loosely like a saw

explanation.surface: Someone heard and saw small children.
explanation.walkthrough: Tots looks like a noun for children; it is the verb, as in tots up.
explanation.definitionFit: To tot up figures is to sum them.

clue.text: Affirm where cricket fan may be found?

definitions.meaning: affirm means declare to be true

definitions.text: where cricket fan may be found?
definitions.meaning: a cricket fan may be at a Test match, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: To declare something true or bear witness to it.

clue.text: Demanding American society leader

parts.note: a king is a leader of a country

explanation.surface: A pushy figure at the top of American high society.
explanation.definitionFit: Requesting as a price or requirement, as when a seller names a figure.

clue.text: Harden section of power union after rise

indicators.note: after rise says the hidden letters are read backwards
section of says the answer is a piece inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Hardening a piece of an energy-workers' union.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Harden section' as the definition, but 'section of' is the hidden-word signal; 'after rise' reverses ERUNI in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To accustom someone to hardship toughens them.

clue.text: Not too stodgy, risqué reading

parts.note: lite describes a lighter, less heavy version of something
risqué material is racy

explanation.surface: Light, saucy books as a reading choice.
explanation.definitionFit: The ability to read and write is basic literacy.

clue.text: Copper's timid and soft

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper; 's means is
shy means timid

explanation.surface: A policeman who is timid and weak.
explanation.walkthrough: Copper suggests a police officer; it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft job is an easy one, comfortable and undemanding.

clue.text: Asian food served in heart of Uruguay

indicators.note: served in says the dish is inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: An Asian dish on the menu in central Uruguay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heart of' looks like a middle-letter signal; the answer runs across hearT OF Uruguay.
explanation.definitionFit: Bean curd is a staple of East Asian cooking.

clue.text: Resentment of booming female?

parts.note: the bittern is a marsh bird famed for its booming call
-ess is a suffix forming female nouns, as in lioness

explanation.surface: Bitterness felt by a loud woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The ESS ending makes a female bittern, the marsh bird with a booming call.
explanation.definitionFit: Resentment is a feeling of grievance and sourness.

clue.text: Persuade earl overcome by dissolute living to take Ecstasy

indicators.note: to take adds the drug's letter at the end
overcome by puts the earl's letter inside the rearranged letters
dissolute suggests disorder, so the letters of living are rearranged

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for the drug Ecstasy

explanation.surface: Coaxing a debauched aristocrat into taking drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dissolute' rearranges living to INVIGL; 'overcome by' sets E inside, making INVEIGL; 'to take' adds E for Ecstasy.
explanation.definitionFit: To coax someone into something by flattery or trickery.

clue.text: Did you draw old pattern on fabric?

parts.note: did draw, meaning drew a match, gives tied
ye is an old form of you

explanation.surface: Asking whether someone sketched an antique design on cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Did ... draw' is a past tense, drew, as in a drawn game; 'old' marks the archaic YE.
explanation.definitionFit: A craft technique for patterning cloth by knotting it before dyeing.
